tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Searches offers when the user asks for them, filtered by category (one_time, monthly, addon, or hepsi = all), optional city and optional maximum price in TRY. Returns matching offers sorted by sort_by (price | rating | relevance; default price, lowest first) and shows them as cards. No paid or spons

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compares offers the user has explicitly asked to compare (by offer IDs from search_offers, or by category/city). If no IDs are given, returns up to 5 matching offers sorted by sort_by (default: the 5 lowest-priced). Returns offers with a card view. No paid or sponsored ranking. Operator-owned Aegis

tools.name: get_offer_link
tools.description: Returns the provider page URL for a single offer ID from search_offers. Read-only; does not book or purchase. Links point to aegisscanner.com (operator-owned).
